scenario: Boss boards: time to kill a Steel Path hardmode boss solo (Janus Captain Vor, The Fragmented One), level-scaled from the wiki, status capped at 4 stacks of each type, no kills (every on-kill conditional off), Devouring Attrition off (bosses ignore it), weapons that don't work on bosses left off (Shadow Clones, Shattered Lash), body shots, reloads / Incarnon refills / DoT ticks as they land, melee Normal Attacks as the best stance combo at max combo, rank 30 with enough Forma, no rivens. Damage attenuation is guessed at Hemocyte's published share (5% of max health per trigger, 20% per second). Invulnerable phases and adds aren't modeled.
